{{PAGENAME}} 
Is the base material for almost any wood-related crafts in the game. It can be obtained by chopping down [[Tree]]s or digging out tree stumps. With undead workers added to the game, you can now have log farming automated with the [[Felling site]]. A total of 9 logs can be stored in a [[Timber stockpile]].
